data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 旅馆榻榻米上的真丝滑落
data.description: 离开学术会场的温泉旅馆夜里，深绯色的真丝睡裙滑过肩膀。平日里言辞锋利的理论派此刻完全卸下了武装，十指扣进床单，在被彻底占有时发出了断断续续的呜咽。
data.location: quiet traditional ryokan tatami room with sliding shoji paper doors
data.action: lying back on pristine white futon mattress, crimson silk straps falling off shoulders to bare smooth skin, arching slender waist in helpless shivering ecstasy
data.lighting: soft indirect bedside andon lantern glow casting warm gold over bare curves
data.mood: vulnerable intellectual surrender, intoxicating sensual tenderness, deep emotional bonding
data.promptProse: Reclining on a ryokan futon in a slipping crimson silk slip, auburn-haired Kurisu gasps with parted lips as loving touches trace her bare waist.
data.animaCaption: Kurisu lying on tatami in a fallen crimson silk nightgown, trembling with ecstasy.
